top_signals.title: The Army’s Command-and-Control Reboot
top_signals.summary:
How the Army makes decisions, communicates orders, coordinates forces, and keeps operations moving toward a common goal is undergoing a revolution. It’s called Next Generation Command and Control. Two of its architects — Lt. Gen. Matthew W. McFarlane, commanding general of I Corps, and Maj. Gen. Patrick J. Ellis, commanding general of the 4th Infantry Division — joined us to discuss this important set of organizational and technological innovations.Our thanks to AeroVironment for sponsoring the event at which this episode was recorded.Image: Kathryn Bailey via DVIDS

The post The Army’s Command-and-Control Reboot appeared first on War on the Rocks.

top_signals.title: ArcelorMittal Sees Profit Boost From Tougher EU Steel Curbs
top_signals.summary: ArcelorMittal SA’s third-quarter earnings came in just above expectations, giving investors an an early read on how the European Union’s trade curbs have affected its biggest steelmaker.
